title: 第3章 兰月儿第4章 圣宗坊市捡漏
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神

;;
兰月儿并未理会李安，一双灵动的眸子激动地扫视着炼丹房，却并未见到其他炼丹师。
那壮魂丹的气息，也是消失得无影无踪。
“怎么会？刚刚明明感知到了！”
兰月儿黛眉微皱，她的灵魂已经触及虚境多年，然而始终无法突破到九品下，在丹房，只能是一个火工童子。
无法成为真正的九品下炼丹师。
她此前也是服用过许多提升神识的丹药，但身体已经产生了很强的耐药性。
可刚刚那一道壮魂丹的气息，却让她隐约有了一丝突破的迹象。
当即，兰月儿那明亮的目光，逐渐迅速转移到了李安身上。
李安只是杂役弟子，他怎么可能接触到那般高品质的壮魂丹？
可她笃定自己的感知没有错！
当即，她里里外外探查了一番，没有丹药，唯独李安身上有些许壮魂丹的气息。
这应该是他清理炼丹炉废渣，沾染上的气息。
见此，她有些失望地叹息一声，刚准备转身离开，却像是发现了什么，饶有兴趣地望着李安，轻声开口道：
“师弟看着很面生，新来的杂役弟子？”
李安内心顿时闪过一丝不妙之色。
在丹圣宗，前辈、师姐、师兄突然关心，这并非是什么好事，而是十有八九准备对你“掏心掏肺”。
兰月儿这一副要吃了自己的眼神，他很熟悉，此前在外门大师姐宁荣荣身上见到过。
此前若非是阴阳炉相助，他恐怕早就被吸干了。
这才过去了多久，这个兰月儿居然又盯上了自己刚刚有巨大提升的灵魂。

这丹圣宗，不让改名叫‘初圣宗’更为合适。
完全将他们这些入门弟子当做了修行资源！
李安心中不忿，但表面上却是开口恭维道：
“师姐，师弟才刚入门没多久，神识孱弱，怎么能与你这样要成为九品炼丹师的师姐相比？”
听到‘九品炼丹师’，兰月儿忍不住微眯起了眼睛，轻笑道：
“师弟倒是嘴甜，不过可惜，你灵魂强盛，依旧被囚于泥丸宫内，无法破宫而出，又是五行废灵根，难以修行到练气五层。”
兰月儿轻叹一声。
李安闻言，立刻想到之前灵魂试图冲出眉心，却遭遇了重重阻碍，想必就是因为泥丸宫的束缚吧？
若是其他五行废灵根修士，或许灵魂不可能突破泥丸宫。
可是自己有阴阳炉相助，只要服用大量提升神识的丹药，必然可以冲破泥丸宫！
兰月儿这番看似审判决断的言语，反倒是让李安看到了希望。
只是，兰月儿对自己说这番话，必然还有下文。
“你虽然难以突破泥丸宫，不过也并非完全没有机会。”
说到这里，兰月儿眯着那一双好看的眸子，轻舔了一下红唇。
然后将那玉手伸进了胸口，从一阵让李安眼花的雪白浪花中，抽出了一页散发出淡淡香味的黑纸，递给了李安。
“这是《小魂决》，以你的灵魂，必然可以修行入门，修行入门之后，定然可以冲破泥丸宫，修行到小成，就有资格成为我这样的火工童子，若是大成，那就可以成为九品炼丹师！”
听到这话，李安无疑有些心动，毕竟成为炼丹师的机会就摆在眼前！
不过，李安也清楚这兰月儿一看就是利用自己。
这《小魂决》只怕是问题。

Lan Yue'er ignored Li An and scanned the alchemy room excitedly with a pair of smart eyes, but did not see any other alchemists.
The aura of the Soul-Strengthening Pill also disappeared without a trace.
"How could it be? I just felt it!"
Lan Yue'er frowned slightly. Her soul had been in the virtual realm for many years, but she had never been able to break through to the ninth level. In the alchemy room, she could only be a pyrotechnical boy.
He cannot become a true ninth-grade alchemist.
She had taken many pills to enhance her consciousness before, but her body had developed a strong resistance to them.
But the aura of the soul-strengthening pill just now gave her a hint of a breakthrough.
Immediately, Lan Yue'er's bright eyes gradually and quickly shifted to Li An.
Li An is just a handyman disciple, how could he have access to such high-quality soul-strengthening pills?
But she was sure that her perception was correct!
Immediately, she checked inside and out. There was no elixir, but Li An had some aura of soul-strengthening elixir.
This should be the aura he picked up from cleaning up the waste residue from the alchemy furnace.
Seeing this, she sighed with some disappointment, and was about to turn around and leave, but she seemed to have discovered something. She looked at Li An with interest and said softly:
"Junior brother looks very unfamiliar, a new handyman disciple?"
A hint of something bad suddenly flashed in Li An's heart.
In the Alchemy Sect, when your seniors, senior sisters, and senior brothers suddenly become concerned, this is not a good thing, but it is a nine out of ten chance that they are ready to "rip their heart out" for you.
Lan Yue'er's look of wanting to eat him was very familiar to him. He had seen it before from Ning Rongrong, the senior sister of the outer sect.
If it hadn't been for the help of Yin Yang Furnace before, he might have been sucked dry long ago.
How long had passed before Lan Yue'er actually set her sights on her soul, which had just been greatly improved.
It would be more appropriate for this Dan Sheng Sect to be renamed the 'Chu Sheng Sect'.
He completely regards these entry-level disciples as cultivation resources!
Li An was unhappy in his heart, but on the surface he complimented:
"Senior Sister, Junior Brother has only just started and his spiritual consciousness is weak. How can he compare with Senior Sister like you who wants to become a ninth-grade alchemist?"
When she heard 'Ninth Grade Alchemist', Lan Yue'er couldn't help but narrowed her eyes slightly and chuckled:
"Junior brother is sweet, but it's a pity that your soul is strong, but you are still imprisoned in the Niwan Palace, unable to break out of the palace, and your Five Elements spirit roots are useless, making it difficult to practice to the fifth level of Qi training."
Lan Yue'er sighed softly.
When Li An heard this, he immediately thought that his soul had tried to break out of his eyebrows before, but had encountered many obstacles. It must have been because of the constraints of Niwan Palace, right?
If it were other five-element spiritual root monks, it might be impossible for their souls to break through the Niwan Palace.
But with the help of the Yin and Yang Furnace, as long as he takes a large amount of pills to enhance his spiritual consciousness, he will definitely be able to break through the Niwan Palace!
Lan Yue'er's words, which seemed like a judgment, actually gave Li An hope.
However, there must be something more to what Lan Yue'er said to herself.
"Although it is difficult for you to break through Niwan Palace, it is not completely impossible for you to have a chance."
Having said this, Lan Yue'er squinted her beautiful eyes and licked her red lips.
Then he put his jade hand into his chest, pulled out a page of black paper that exuded a faint fragrance from the snow-white waves that dazzled Li An, and handed it to Li An.
"This is the "Little Soul Art". With your soul, you will definitely be able to practice and get started. After you get started, you will definitely be able to break through the Niwan Palace. If you reach a small level of cultivation, you will be qualified to become a fire worker boy like me. If you achieve a big level of cultivation, you can become a ninth-grade alchemist!"
Hearing this, Li An was undoubtedly a little moved. After all, the opportunity to become an alchemist was right in front of him!
However, Li An also knew that Lan Yue'er was taking advantage of him at first sight.
This "Little Soul Jue" is probably a problem.
